description: This file defines the AttachmentFilePath class, which provides methods to generate file names, resolve directory paths, and generate complete file paths for attachments in the application.

classes.name: AttachmentFilePath
classes.description: Provides methods for handling file path generation related to attachment storage.

methods.name: GenerateFileName
methods.description: Creates a unique filename using a GUID, optionally appending an extension.

methods.name: GetDirectory
methods.description: Resolves and returns the directory path where attachment files are stored.

methods.name: GenerateFilePath
methods.description: Combines the directory path with a given file path to generate a full file path.
